findings.note: The step text says the range uses the along-incline part of gravity, but the equation only restates T (already found in step 3) and asserts R with no working; a student cannot see how 39.04 m was obtained. Both numbers are correct.

notes: Independent solve (both incline axes and ground axes): T = 2u sin15°/(g cos30°) = 1.6906 s; R = u cos15° T − ½ g sin30° T² = 39.043 m (ground axes: x = 33.8 m, y = 19.5 m, y/x = tan30°). Closed forms 4(3−√3)/3 and 160(√3−1)/3 verified. common_mistakes[0]: flat-ground formulas give 4 s and 80 m - correct. common_mistakes[1]: sin(45°+30°) in place of sin(45°−30°) in T = 2u sin(θ−β)/(g cosβ) and R = 2u² cosθ sin(θ−β)/(g cos²β) gives 6.31 s and 145.71 m, which are the down-incline formulas - the entry is correct as written.
